items.title: Marathon Concurrent Player Count Falls to 1,618
items.summary: SteamDB data shows Marathon had 1,618 concurrent players as of November 23, a steep drop from its all-time peak of 88,337 reached at launch on March 6, 2026. The 24-hour peak was only 2,904 players, underscoring the sustained low engagement the extraction shooter has faced since launch.
items.credibility_note: SteamDB is a widely used third-party stats tracker, not an official Valve or Bungie source, though its concurrent player figures are generally considered reliable.

items.title: Context: Marathon's Symbiosis Update Confirmed for December 8
items.summary: Bungie announced on November 10, 2026 that its Symbiosis update will launch December 8, adding a permanent PvE roguelite mode called Expedition, a new social hub called Limbo, a Team Deathmatch beta mode, and a melee-focused runner shell named Bishop. Multiple outlets framed the update as a make-or-break moment for the game given weak player retention since its March launch, and it will include a free-to-play Open Play Week from December 8 to 15.
items.credibility_note: Direct announcement from Bungie's press site, corroborated by multiple established gaming outlets.

items.title: Context: Bungie Says Marathon Needs to Evolve After Missing Player Targets
items.summary: In an October 29, 2026 community update, Bungie acknowledged that Marathon has not reached its player count targets and said the game needs more depth, variety, stronger progression, and better long-term reasons for players to return. The studio said a Developer Insights video detailing these changes would arrive in early December, ahead of the Symbiosis update.
items.credibility_note: Official community update statement directly from Bungie.
